items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Some of them were when they had a big star like Ethel Waters or people like that. Peg Leg Bates.

ctx.x: How did you feel about the Cotton Club shows? Were they good? (Inaudible)?
The Cotton Club? Sure, Some of them were when they had a big star like Ethel Waters or people like that. Peg Leg Bates. It was a very good show.
Connie's Inn had good shows too. Oh, that was run by gangsters. Small's Paradise, too, had good shows.
